result.brief: 提出基于PI步长控制的扩散采样自适应二阶求解器，并聚合为固定调度，在图像与语言扩散上以FID/困惑度评估。
result.reason: Adaptive step-size solvers for diffusion sampling; no video/world-model, representation, or unified understanding-generation contribution. Pure image/language generation efficiency, no stated transfer to video generation.
